purpose: Expose HTTP/1 parser start time for one header/body receive budget; retain fresh silent and six-second keep-alive idle deadlines; send header 408 through the existing buffered error path only when previous output is absent.
timingScope: Parser-observation time. Exact expiry of a later pipelined request behind a long streaming response is not established.
maintenance: Reapply and requalify the four-file patch when upgrading Hyper. The application and fixture workspaces must use this same Cargo patch.
